Apple___Apple_scab.name: Apple - Apple scab
Apple___Apple_scab.description: Velvety, olive-green to black spots on leaves and fruit. Leaves may turn yellow and drop early. Fruit may be deformed or cracked.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Velvety, olive-green to black spots on leaves and fruit. Leaves may turn yellow and drop early. Fruit may be deformed or cracked.

Apple___Black_rot.name: Apple - Black rot
Apple___Black_rot.description: Firm, reddish-brown, circular spots on fruit that turn black and rotten. Leaves show frog-eye leaf spots (circular brown spots with purple margins).
Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Firm, reddish-brown, circular spots on fruit that turn black and rotten. Leaves show frog-eye leaf spots (circular brown spots with purple margins).

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.name: Apple - Cedar apple rust
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.description: Bright yellow-orange spots on upper leaf surface, later developing tiny black dots. Underside of leaves may have tube-like structures.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Bright yellow-orange spots on upper leaf surface, later developing tiny black dots. Underside of leaves may have tube-like structures.

Apple___healthy.name: Apple - healthy
Apple___healthy.description: Leaves are vibrant green. No dark spots. No rust. No brown lesions. No yellowing. Fruit is firm and unblemished.
Apple___healthy.symptoms: Leaves are vibrant green. No dark spots. No rust. No brown lesions. No yellowing. Fruit is firm and unblemished.

Blueberry___healthy.name: Blueberry - healthy
Blueberry___healthy.description: Leaves are dark green, glossy. No spots. No red discoloration. Stems are sturdy.
Blueberry___healthy.symptoms: Leaves are dark green, glossy. No spots. No red discoloration. Stems are sturdy.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.name: Cherry (including sour) - Powdery mildew
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.description: White, powdery fungus growth on leaves and fruit. Leaves may curl upward or become distorted.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White, powdery fungus growth on leaves and fruit. Leaves may curl upward or become distorted.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.name: Cherry (including sour) - healthy
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.description: Foliage is green and clean. No white powdery fungus. No curling. No holes.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.symptoms: Foliage is green and clean. No white powdery fungus. No curling. No holes.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.name: Corn (maize) - Cercospora leaf spot Gray leaf spot
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.description: Small, rectangular, tan to brown lesions on leaves, often limited by leaf veins. Lesions turn gray with age.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.symptoms: Small, rectangular, tan to brown lesions on leaves, often limited by leaf veins. Lesions turn gray with age.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.name: Corn (maize) - Common rust
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.description: Small, powdery, cinnamon-brown to red pustules on both leaf surfaces. Pustules turn black as plants mature.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.symptoms: Small, powdery, cinnamon-brown to red pustules on both leaf surfaces. Pustules turn black as plants mature.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.name: Corn (maize) - Northern Leaf Blight
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.description: Long, elliptical, grayish-green or tan lesions ('cigar-shaped') on leaves. Can cause significant blight.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long, elliptical, grayish-green or tan lesions ('cigar-shaped') on leaves. Can cause significant blight.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.name: Corn (maize) - healthy
Corn_(maize)___healthy.description: Stalks are strong. Leaves are uniform green. No streaks. No gray spots. No rust pustules.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.symptoms: Stalks are strong. Leaves are uniform green. No streaks. No gray spots. No rust pustules.

Grape___Black_rot.name: Grape - Black rot
Grape___Black_rot.description: Reddish-brown spots on leaves. Fruit shrivels into hard, black, wrinkled 'mummies'.
Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Reddish-brown spots on leaves. Fruit shrivels into hard, black, wrinkled 'mummies'.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).name: Grape - Esca (Black Measles)
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).description: Yellowish or reddish stripes between leaf veins ('tiger stripes'). Fruit develops small, dark spots (measles).
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).symptoms: Yellowish or reddish stripes between leaf veins ('tiger stripes'). Fruit develops small, dark spots (measles).

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.name: Grape - Leaf blight (Isariopsis Leaf Spot)
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.description: Irregular, dark red to brown spots on leaves with a yellow halo. Underside may have fuzzy growth.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.symptoms: Irregular, dark red to brown spots on leaves with a yellow halo. Underside may have fuzzy growth.

Grape___healthy.name: Grape - healthy
Grape___healthy.description: Vines are vigorous. Leaves are green and palm-shaped. No brown spots. No black rot. No shriveling.
Grape___healthy.symptoms: Vines are vigorous. Leaves are green and palm-shaped. No brown spots. No black rot. No shriveling.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).name: Orange - Haunglongbing (Citrus greening)
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).description: Yellowing of leaf veins or mottling (blotchy patches). Fruit remains small, green, and bitter (misshapen).
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).symptoms: Yellowing of leaf veins or mottling (blotchy patches). Fruit remains small, green, and bitter (misshapen).

Peach___Bacterial_spot.name: Peach - Bacterial spot
Peach___Bacterial_spot.description: Small, water-soaked spots on leaves that turn dark and may fall out ('shot hole' effect). Fruit has surface pitting or cracking.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked spots on leaves that turn dark and may fall out ('shot hole' effect). Fruit has surface pitting or cracking.

Peach___healthy.name: Peach - healthy
Peach___healthy.description: Leaves are long, lance-shaped, and green. No bacterial spots. No holes. No curling.
Peach___healthy.symptoms: Leaves are long, lance-shaped, and green. No bacterial spots. No holes. No curling.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.name: Pepper, bell - Bacterial spot
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.description: Small, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit. Spots turn brown/black and slightly raised.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit. Spots turn brown/black and slightly raised.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.name: Pepper, bell - healthy
Pepper,_bell___healthy.description: Leaves are smooth and green. No bacterial spots. No water-soaked lesions. Fruit is glossy.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.symptoms: Leaves are smooth and green. No bacterial spots. No water-soaked lesions. Fruit is glossy.

Potato___Early_blight.name: Potato - Early blight
Potato___Early_blight.description: Dark brown spots with concentric rings ('bullseye' pattern) on older leaves. Yellowing around spots.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings ('bullseye' pattern) on older leaves. Yellowing around spots.

Potato___Late_blight.name: Potato - Late blight
Potato___Late_blight.description: Large, irregular, dark green to black water-soaked lesions on leaves. White fuzzy mold on undersides in wet weather.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large, irregular, dark green to black water-soaked lesions on leaves. White fuzzy mold on undersides in wet weather.

Potato___healthy.name: Potato - healthy
Potato___healthy.description: Foliage is bushy and green. No dark brown spots. No concentric rings. No mold.
Potato___healthy.symptoms: Foliage is bushy and green. No dark brown spots. No concentric rings. No mold.

Raspberry___healthy.name: Raspberry - healthy
Raspberry___healthy.description: Canes are brown/green depending on variety. Leaves are clean. No spots. No yellowing.
Raspberry___healthy.symptoms: Canes are brown/green depending on variety. Leaves are clean. No spots. No yellowing.

Soybean___healthy.name: Soybean - healthy
Soybean___healthy.description: Leaves are trifoliate, green. No pustules. No yellowing. No leaf spots.
Soybean___healthy.symptoms: Leaves are trifoliate, green. No pustules. No yellowing. No leaf spots.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.name: Squash - Powdery mildew
Squash___Powdery_mildew.description: White, talcum-like powder patches on leaves, stems, and fruit. Leaves may yellow and wither.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White, talcum-like powder patches on leaves, stems, and fruit. Leaves may yellow and wither.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.name: Strawberry - Leaf scorch
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.description: Irregular, dark purple or reddish spots on leaves. The spots may coalesce, causing the leaf to look scorched or burnt.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.symptoms: Irregular, dark purple or reddish spots on leaves. The spots may coalesce, causing the leaf to look scorched or burnt.

Strawberry___healthy.name: Strawberry - healthy
Strawberry___healthy.description: Leaves are bright green with serrated edges. No purple spots. No red spots. No scorching.
Strawberry___healthy.symptoms: Leaves are bright green with serrated edges. No purple spots. No red spots. No scorching.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.name: Tomato - Bacterial spot
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.description: Small, dark, greasy-looking spots on leaves and stems. Fruit often has scab-like, raised brown spots.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, dark, greasy-looking spots on leaves and stems. Fruit often has scab-like, raised brown spots.

Tomato___Early_blight.name: Tomato - Early blight
Tomato___Early_blight.description: Brown spots with concentric rings (target-like) on lower leaves first. Leaves turn yellow and drop.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings (target-like) on lower leaves first. Leaves turn yellow and drop.

Tomato___Late_blight.name: Tomato - Late blight
Tomato___Late_blight.description: Large, irregular, pale green to brown lesions. White cottony growth on leaf undersides during high humidity.
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large, irregular, pale green to brown lesions. White cottony growth on leaf undersides during high humidity.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.name: Tomato - Leaf Mold
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.description: Pale yellow spots on upper leaf surface. Olive-green to brown velvety mold on the underside of the spots.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale yellow spots on upper leaf surface. Olive-green to brown velvety mold on the underside of the spots.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.name: Tomato - Septoria leaf spot
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.description: Numerous small, circular spots with dark borders and gray centers. Lower leaves affected first.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Numerous small, circular spots with dark borders and gray centers. Lower leaves affected first.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.name: Tomato - Spider mites Two-spotted spider mite
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.description: Leaves look stippled (tiny yellow dots). Fine webbing may be visible. Mites are tiny red/yellow specks.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.symptoms: Leaves look stippled (tiny yellow dots). Fine webbing may be visible. Mites are tiny red/yellow specks.

Tomato___Target_Spot.name: Tomato - Target Spot
Tomato___Target_Spot.description: Brown to black lesions with concentric rings, similar to early blight but often with a yellow halo.
Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Tomato___Target_Spot.symptoms: Brown to black lesions with concentric rings, similar to early blight but often with a yellow halo.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.name: Tomato - Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.description: Leaves curl upward and turn yellow at the edges. Plants are stunted. Flowers may drop.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.symptoms: Leaves curl upward and turn yellow at the edges. Plants are stunted. Flowers may drop.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.name: Tomato - Tomato mosaic virus
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.description: Mottled light and dark green pattern on leaves (mosaic). Leaves may be filiform (stringy) or fern-like.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: Isolate the plant. Remove affected leaves. Apply appropriate fungicide or organic remedy.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green pattern on leaves (mosaic). Leaves may be filiform (stringy) or fern-like.

Tomato___healthy.name: Tomato - healthy
Tomato___healthy.description: Vigorous growth. Compound green leaves. No dark spots. No yellowing. No curling. No mosaic pattern. No mold.
Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous growth. Compound green leaves. No dark spots. No yellowing. No curling. No mosaic pattern. No mold.
